title: SPEC TOPICS IN APPLIED MATH
description: May be repeated for credit. Topics and instructors from the Applied Mathematics Committee and the staff change from year to year. For advanced undergraduate students and graduate students in engineering, physical sciences, biological sciences, and other fields. Examples of topics include multi-scale analysis and Applied Harmonic Analysis
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Advanced calculus and junior year applied mathematics, or their equivalents.
